topic: Duterte defense team requests prosecution 'reframe' crimes against humanity charges
tweet1: Duterte's defense team asked prosecutors to 'reframe' crimes against humanity charges before pre-trial. Philippine Star reports it today — no explanation of what 'reframe' means or why.
tweet2: Defense didn't file a motion to dismiss. Didn't challenge jurisdiction. They're asking prosecutors to rewrite the charges themselves. That's not how adversarial trials work — that's negotiation.
tweet3: Ortega spent ₱5M exposing 'misleading' flood photos. SC ruled affidavits of desistance can't dismiss trafficking cases. But crimes against humanity charges get workshopped with the defense first?
tweet4: If prosecutors agree to 'reframe' before pre-trial, we'll know procedural rules only apply when power wants them to. Pre-trial starts when — October? Watch if charges change before then.
